title: ポケットモンスター 赤

versions.note: the Japanese Red cartridge (POKEMON RED, header checksum 0x32)

sources: The harness alone, from the game's cartridge on mGBA (docs/first-script.md): no reader's snapshots, no memory written, no play outside the harness. The cartridge and snaps were studied outside it

The table: read off the game's own font in the cartridge, found with rom-font --find from one picture (1 bit a pixel, 8x8, glyph n at 0x10801 + 8n; code = n + 0x1D). The offset was found with find_relative on one line in play, and 3 signs outside that font were read in play
The window was found in the game's copy of the screen's tiles in work RAM, and when a page waits in its arrow; a probe script followed the rows and the arrow frame by frame

Played from the opening's talk through the rival's naming and the end of the opening, the hero's mother at home, and the professor in the grass and his lab: four stretches, each replayed from a state with the script loaded
What the script said agreed with the rows read off 45 of 45 pictures, over 4 scenes; it said nothing on the 2 screens without text
The rows were the script's pages, each held against its picture. In the lab the presses came 300 frames apart, as a reader reading; at 150 one page was said after it had closed (see notes)
122 harness calls in all (by the record), none failed
notes: Read by the script games/gb/GB-29D07340.lua: the message window's two rows when the page waits on its arrow, or once they have stood half a second. A page that ends without the arrow and is closed sooner than that is said after it has gone, as the game's copy of the screen keeps it. Not read: who speaks but where the game writes it into the text, menus and other boxes, battles (not looked at). Names chosen in play come out as typed.
